test_std_exception: test that pybind11 throws a standard RuntimeError with an intentional message from C++
test_cross_module_exceptions: test cross-module exception handling including RuntimeError, ValueError, TypeError, and custom exceptions across pybind11 modules
test_custom: test custom exception types like MyException and MyException5 including subclassing and translation to standard Python exceptions
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling with try_catch and custom exception types
test_local_translator: test that a local exception translator works in isolation and does not leak across pybind11 modules
